Indeterminate — I could not reproduce the reported ad on www⁠.maxon.net/en/downloads with the reporter's own Base+Tracking baseline:⁠ the reported text "Log in and download the Maxon app." appears nowhere in the page HTML (also checked /en and /en/sale), et.maxon.net made no request among 469 HAR entries, no ad loader or overlay is present, and 30 s of waiting/scroll produced no popup. The run instruction's filter policy states no rule that closes this report:⁠ it is not a paywall, not an anti-adblock wall, and not a scam/phishing case, so rule generation is not blocked. Closing is recommended on reproduction grounds only:⁠ the reported ad element and the reported tracker host are absent from the successfully loaded reported page in every session and page variant examined.

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — amj30.com's homepage opens two self-owned modal popups (the reporter's "请务必牢记回家地址" alternate-domain notice and a "站点公告" notice) that dim the page and lock scrolling; blocking the routing script or stubbing showModal failed because the site falls back to the open attribute. The reported symptom is not a paywall, not an anti-adblock wall and not a scam page, so none of the instruction's close-or-hand-off rules applies.
